Hi Elena,

Thanks for the meeting this morning. As promised, attached is a first draft of a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the endstate playbook, the evaluation/acceptance tests we propose, and a suggested close timeline. Key points up front:

- Objective: Validate Redwood inference integration in ClarifyHealth staging with production-like load and quality checks, then cutover to dedicated capacity.
- Proposed milestone cadence: 2-week sprint for integration -> 2-week pilot (limited traffic) -> 2-week scale validation -> signoff.
- Success anchors (examples in the attached workbook): latency P95 <= 350ms for text-generation paths, token fidelity concordance >= 97% on canonical prompt set, smoke regression pass-rate >= 95% for 48h.
- Exit gates: (1) infra & routing smoke pass, (2) data handling checklist closed, (3) quality signal thresholds met for 48h, (4) procurement & SOC 2 evidence provided.

Attachments: Clarify_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (MAP master) and eval-verification-suite.pdf (detailed test cases and evidence matrix).

Can you confirm who from your side will be the operational owner for the verification run, and whether the procurement contact needs a separate pricing milestone to unlock pilot capacity? If the thresholds above look reasonable we can version this to v1.0 and schedule the kickoff for 2026-10-04.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a working MAP.

—

Thanks for the draft — this is helpful and much clearer than the notes we took. A few clarifying questions from our side before we lock the MAP:

1) Acceptance thresholds: for the "token fidelity concordance" you listed 97%. Can you explain how you measure concordance (exact match vs. semantic)? We'll need a reproducible test harness and the canonical prompt set.

2) Load targets: our staging cluster won't run full production traffic during the pilot. Can we define an equivalence factor (e.g., 25% of prod qps for pilot, with a plan to ramp to 75% during scale validation)?

3) Evidence & compliance: procurement needs SOC 2 evidence and a list of logs we can pull for a 30-day audit window.

If you can incorporate short answers to the above in the MAP and confirm the operational owner, procurement can confirm whether we can approve pilot spend scoped to the first two milestones.

Marissa — forwarding Elena's questions and our proposed answers to include in v1.0 of the MAP. High level proposals:

- Concordance measurement: define two tiers in the test harness. Exact-match for structured outputs (where applicable) and a token-level edit-distance / BLEU-like score for generative responses. For the SLA we recommend: structured fields 99% exact, generative prompts target 0.03 avg normalized edit distance (~97% semantic fidelity). We'll add the canonical prompt set to the drive link and a small runner to reproduce scores.

- Equivalent load plan: agree pilot at 25% prod qps for functional validation (collect KV/cache hit curves), scale validation at 75% for 48h. We'll make clear what metrics we expect at each ramp (P95 latency, tail CPU/GPU utilization, KV cache hit-rate).

- SOC 2 / evidence: supply SOC 2 attestation copy and a runsheet of available logs (request logs via shared S3 path; list to include request/response ids, region, model variant, timestamp). We'll include a 30-day retention option in the MAP and note who from our infra team will be the contact.

Attachments to add: short test-run templates (smoke, regression, load) and a verification owner table. Suggest Marissa propose the kickoff once you incorporate these answers.

—Ben & Jordan

Elena & team,

Thanks for the quick review. I've incorporated Ben and Jordan's proposals into v1.0 of the MAP (attached) and answered the three bullets below inline so procurement has the detail it needs. If this looks good we can treat v1.0 as the canonical MAP and start the kickoff on 2026-10-04.

1) Concordance measurement:
- Structured outputs: exact-match checks as a pass/fail per-case (target 99% pass across canonical cases).
- Generative prompts: normalized edit-distance + manual spot-checks; we capture both the token-level metric and a small human-eval sample for edge cases. Target aggregated concordance >= 97% as noted. The eval-verification-suite.pdf contains the harness and command-line runner.

2) Load equivalence:
- Pilot: 25% prod QPS for 72h with smoke/regression run at the end of the window.
- Scale validation: 75% prod QPS for 48h. We log P50/P95/P99, GPU utilization, and cache hit-rate; exit gate requires P95 latency <= 350ms and no regressions in the smoke run.

3) Evidence & SOC 2:
- Attached SOC 2 attest and an evidence runsheet. Logs will be available (request-based) in S3 for a 30-day retention window; list includes request/response ids, model variant, region, and timestamps. Infra contact: Jordan Blake (jordan@redwood.com).

Next steps: Please reply to this thread with a single-line approval ("ClarifyHealth approves MAP v1.0") and list the operational owner on your side. Procurement: please confirm whether the pilot spend can be provisioned against the milestone schedule; we can add a simple milestone PO if helpful.

Attachments: Clarify_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (MAP canonical), eval-verification-suite.pdf, SOC2-attest.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
